title: Signal: Jenkinsfile served from the web root
scope: One response body containing a declarative pipeline with an agent and a stage.
limitations: One response body. The rule reads the pipeline structure; it does not run a stage.

observation.body: Keep the pipeline block in a Jenkinsfile at the repository root.

fpNotes: A page that quotes a pipeline snippet is reported when it reproduces the pipeline block and an agent directive.
